title: Dynamics simulation and in vitro studies of betulinic acid derivative with liver X receptor.
authors: Yu, Pan; Cao, Weiya; Wang, Yuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子桦木酸衍生物与肝X受体蛋白的分子动力学模拟及体外抗肿瘤实验，对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Molecular dynamics simulation of the dominant conformational conjugate was performed for 40 ns and 100 ns via Amber software based on molecular docking by Sybyl software. Because the RMSD and RMSF of 100 ns MD simulation were higher than that of 40 ns MD simulation, the 40 ns was reasonable and credible for MD simulation. The binding free energy and decomposition free energy of the two systems of betulinic acid, com3 with liver X receptor was calculated by the MM_GBSA and MM_PBSA methods, respectively. The results showed that the two systems reached equilibrium and convergence at 20 ns, both stable at about 2 A, and exhibited low volatility in the range of amino acid 270 to 370 (RMSF <1 A). The binding energy of com3 (DeltaG(bind) = -68.02 kcal/mol by the MM_GBSA method or -55.50 kcal/mol by the MM_PBSA method) with the liver X receptor was lower than that of betulinic acid (DeltaG(bind) = -55.70 kcal/mol or -42.73 kcal/mol) respectively, and van der Waals force was the most important main driving force, which was consistent with molecular docking and previous experiments. Hydrophobic groups and aromatic rings can be introduced appropriately in structure optimization to increase the van der Waals force and pi-pi accumulation effect of betulinic acid and liver X receptor, which is conducive to binding and thereby increasing antitumor activity. The clone formation assay and results of western blotting indicated that BA derivative com3 exposure inhibited cell proliferation may relate to the regulation of the AKT/mTOR pathway in 7721 cells. This study clarifies the dynamic interaction mode and potential mechanism of betulinic acid and its derivatives with the liver X receptor, which provides a new idea for the rapid screening of liver X receptor agonists from traditional Chinese medicines.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 基于Sybyl软件分子对接，利用Amber软件对优势构象复合物进行了40 ns和100 ns的分子动力学模拟。由于100 ns MD模拟的RMSD和RMSF值高于40 ns MD模拟，因此40 ns的MD模拟是合理且可信的。通过MM_GBSA和MM_PBSA方法分别计算了白桦脂酸和com3与肝X受体两个体系的结合自由能及分解自由能。结果表明，两个体系在20 ns时达到平衡并收敛，均稳定在约2 Å，且在氨基酸270至370范围内表现出低波动性（RMSF <1 Å）。com3与肝X受体的结合能（MM_GBSA方法为DeltaG(bind) = -68.02 kcal/mol，MM_PBSA方法为-55.50 kcal/mol）分别低于白桦脂酸（DeltaG(bind) = -55.70 kcal/mol或-42.73 kcal/mol），且范德华力是最重要的主要驱动力，这与分子对接及先前实验一致。在结构优化中可适当引入疏水基团和芳香环，以增强白桦脂酸与肝X受体间的范德华力和pi-pi堆积效应，有利于结合，从而增强抗肿瘤活性。克隆形成实验和Western blotting结果表明，BA衍生物com3暴露抑制细胞增殖可能与7721细胞中AKT/mTOR通路的调控有关。本研究阐明了白桦脂酸及其衍生物与肝X受体的动态相互作用模式及潜在机制，为从传统中药中快速筛选肝X受体激动剂提供了新思路。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
